title: New publication in PNAS
summary: The lab's newest forecasting paper was published in PNAS.
details: Congratulations to coauthors Casey Gibson, Emily Javan, Susan Ptak, Oluwasegun Ibrahim, Michael Lachmann, and Lauren Meyers. The paper introduces epimodulation, a model augmentation approach for improving outbreak forecasts.

title: New CSTE forecasting grant
summary: The Fox Lab received an influenza forecasting grant from CSTE.
details: The grant supports forecasting efforts for the upcoming influenza season and continues a multi-year partnership involving collaborators at UT Austin, Los Alamos National Laboratory, and NAU.

title: Arizona One Health workshop
summary: Spencer represented NAU at the Arizona Department of Health Services One Health workshop in Phoenix.
details: The workshop brought together university, state, and county public health partners to discuss One Health approaches for outbreak response across Arizona.

title: Filming public health modeling training in Austin
summary: Spencer traveled to Austin to film a follow-up modeling training module.
details: The course, Think, Choose, Model: A Public Health Playbook, covers major model types, strengths and limitations, and how to choose the right model for a public health question.

title: SISMID 2025
summary: Spencer taught simulation-based inference for epidemiological dynamics at SISMID.
details: Spencer and Jesse Wheeler taught a revised version of the Simulation-based Inference for Epidemiological Dynamics course at Emory.

title: CDC on-site forecasting meeting
summary: Spencer, Maya, Brynn, and Ehsan met with CDC collaborators to discuss international forecasting work.
details: The group discussed ongoing collaborations with the Global Influenza Branch, including forecasts for Southern Hemisphere respiratory virus activity using FluNet data.

title: CDC InsightNet annual meeting
summary: Brynn Case represented the lab at the CDC InsightNet annual meeting in Utah.
details: Brynn presented work on optimal sample sizes for genomic surveillance in collaboration with the Massachusetts Department of Public Health.

title: Maya presents at CPH Research Day
summary: Maya Salcedo presented work on Bayesian infectious disease forecasting.
details: Maya's poster, A Flexible Framework to Forecast Seasonal Infectious Disease Dynamics Accounting for Spatial Correlations, highlighted the lab's work in infectious disease Bayesian forecasting.

title: Fox Lab CIDD presentation
summary: Spencer gave a presentation at the Center for Infectious Disease Dynamics at Penn State.
details: The talk focused on turning forecasts into actionable public health guidance and lessons from recent forecast models.

title: Ehsan becomes a PhD candidate
summary: Ehsan Suez passed his comprehensive exam and proposal defense.
details: Ehsan's research focuses on infectious disease forecasting, statistical modeling, and data science for public health preparedness.

title: Ehsan accepted to Future Faculty Fellows Program
summary: Ehsan was selected as one of 15 fellows campus-wide for UGA's Future Faculty Fellows Program.
details: The program supports graduate students in advancing teaching, preparing for the academic job market, and transitioning into faculty roles.

title: A very full forecasting week
summary: The lab attended influenza and CSTE forecasting meetings, then held a Fox Lab hackathon.
details: The week included the Ecology and Evolution of Influenza conference at UGA, the CSTE forecasting annual meeting in Atlanta, and a lab hackathon on severe infection risks from potential pandemic influenza.

title: Brynn's award-winning OPTIONS XII presentation
summary: Brynn Case won best presentation in the Public Health and Policy track at OPTIONS XII.
details: Their talk presented real-time forecasts of respiratory hospitalizations in Paraguay in collaboration with CDC and Paraguay's Ministry of Health.

title: Mid-season report in Paraguay
summary: The team traveled to Asuncion to discuss respiratory virus forecasts for healthcare needs.
details: Since April, the lab had been producing respiratory virus forecasts for pediatric and adult healthcare needs in Paraguay.

title: Annie passes the qualifying exam
summary: Annie Cramer passed her qualifying exam.
details: The exam represents completion of core coursework for the PhD program in Epidemiology and Biostatistics.

title: New lab members join the group
summary: Maya Salcedo, Rajath Prabhakar, and Brynn Case joined the Fox Lab.
details: The lab welcomed new members with interests spanning disease modeling, statistical programming, forecasting, and genomic surveillance.

title: Ehsan Suez joins the group
summary: Ehsan joined the lab as a PhD student in Bioinformatics.
details: Ehsan focuses on disease modeling, statistical analysis, and data-driven decision-making.
